PHASE.NAME: RTK Built-in Filter Pack Loader
PHASE.GOAL: Load an additional RTK-style named TOML filter pack beside Synapse legacy built-ins to expand token-saving coverage for lint, build, and ops commands.

STEPS.step-1: Load a separate RTK named filter pack after existing built-in filters without changing project/user priority.
STEPS.step-2: Declare Cargo rebuild tracking for the new embedded filter pack.
STEPS.step-3: Expose the shipped filters command in the machine-readable capability registry.
STEPS.step-4: Verify syn filters can run inline tests from the RTK pack.
STEPS.step-5: Add regression coverage for RTK pack verification through CLI.
STEPS.step-6: Keep public command documentation aligned with the filters capability surface.
